title: Amy Acton
intro:
Amy Acton (Democratic Party) is running for election for Governor of Ohio. She is on the ballot on a joint ticket with David Pepper in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
As of September 2026, Acton was a physician and former director of the Ohio Department of Health.
